title: South Padre Fishing Guide Service w/ Captain Lee
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Capt. Lee’s South Padre Fishing Charters offers Half Day (5-6 hours) and Full Day (8 hours) charters fishing out of Jim’s Pier on South Padre Island, TX. We target a variety of game fish including: Redfish, Speckled Trout, Snook, Flounder, Black Drum, Mangrove Snapper and Kingfish. Lee can accommodate up to 5 anglers on his 21’ Shallow Sport boat.
